settings.title: Charges under any light
settings.text: Sunlight, lamps or your phone torch.

settings.title: Stitched to order
settings.text: Every piece embroidered in your thread colour.

settings.title: Pick your garment
settings.text: Tee, long sleeve, hoodie, joggers or shorts. All heavyweight black cotton, so the glow pops.

settings.title: Choose your thread
settings.text: Blue, green, red, white, pink or orange. Flip the lights off in the preview to see how it glows.

settings.title: We stitch and ship
settings.text: Your logo is embroidered to order in photoluminescent thread, then packed and sent to you.

settings.question: How does the glow work?
settings.answer: The thread is photoluminescent. It soaks up light from the sun, a lamp or a phone torch, then gives it back as a glow in the dark. No batteries or wiring.

settings.question: Which colours glow brightest?
settings.answer: Green glows brightest and longest. White and pink are softer, so they suit a subtler look.

settings.question: Will my piece look exactly like the preview?
settings.answer: The preview is a close guide. Real brightness and glow time depend on the fabric and how long the thread has been charged.

settings.question: Can I choose where the logo goes?
settings.answer: Yes. On each product page, use "Place your logo" to move it left, right, up or down and change its size. We stitch it where you put it.

settings.question: How long until it arrives?
settings.answer: Every piece is stitched to order. Allow 5–7 working days before dispatch.

settings.question: How do I wash it?
settings.answer: Turn it inside out, wash cool at 30°, and don't iron over the embroidery.
